striking u2. w1 then observed u2 tap on u1's window, u1 then backed up her vehicle and drove forward striking u2 with her vehicle then fleeing eastbound from the scene. w2 advised me that she was also at the incident location and witnessed part of the incident. w2 stated that she observed [roadway] of the incident location and u1 backing her vehicle and striking u2 before fleeing the scene. traffic investigations detail investigation s. mena #2027 was advised of the situation. o1 showed me video surveillance of the incident captured on her store's security cameras. on camera 14 at about 2315 hours (the store's security camera time is not calibrated correctly) u1 is seen driving westbound through the incident location, u1 then turns a corner at what appears to be a high rate of speed and forward striking u2. u1 flees eastbound from the incident location without ever exiting her vehicle to attempt to render aid or otherwise check on v1's condition. u2 was transported from the scene by records.public_safe_text: on friday, september 9, 2022, police responded to the area of w 24th and yonkers in reference to a major traffic accident involving two pedestrians being struck by a vehicle. while en route, dispatch advised that the pedestrians had been [medical facility] plainview. upon arrival, i observed a blue, ford mustang bearing texas license plate # [roadway] facing eastbound. i spoke with the driver of the vehicle, identified as (d) kaitlyn gaither (w/f [date]). she advised that she had just pulled out of a parking lot on the north side of the roadway in the 2600 block of w 24th when she struck a male, identified as (p) justin borum (w/m [date]), who was carrying a child, (p) bentley borum (w/m [date]). kaitlyn stated that the two pedestrians were her family. she stated that justin is her stepfather, and bentley is her little brother. kaitlyn said that justin jumped onto the hood of the car at the time of impact, still holding bentley, and then slid onto the roadway when the vehicle came to a stop. i then spoke with a witness that had approached from the roadside but did not wish to identify himself. the witness stated that he saw kaitlyn turn out of the parking lot when justin walked into the roadway without paying attention to any oncoming traffic. i took photographs of the vehicle and the scene. i observed minimal damage to the hood scoop of the vehicle. kaitlyn then moved the vehicle to the parking lot on the north side of w 24th and was then [medical facility] to be with her family. [medical facility] to meet with justin and bentley. i observed bentley sitting on his grandmother's lap. i observed that he had only minor abrasions to his knees. i spoke to justin who stated that he had walked out into the roadway without paying attention. justin said that his injuries were not severe. i observed justin had a small amount of blood on his left hand. i asked justin if he was able to stand so i could take photographs [medical facility] bed i observed that he was not able to put weight on his left leg. i took photographs of justin's visible injuries and provided him with the [case id] for the accident report. i determined that justin was at fault in the accident due to a violation of transportation code 552. 0025 - crossing at a point other than a crosswalk.

records.deidentified_narrative: on tuesday, september 6, 2022 at approximately 1139 hours, i, officer m. echols #565, officer d. hatley #571, and sgt. d. simmons #441 were dispatched to a vehicle/[roadway] [medical facility] located at [roadway] dallas, texas 75237 in dallas county. upon arrival i observed a silver toyota camry with texas license plate [identifier] on the [roadway] [roadway]. the driver of that vehicle later identified as amparo vega ramos was standing at the front of the vehicle, and officer hatley was kneeling down beside the victim later identified as doris wang graham. graham was laying on her right side. graham was alert but had head trauma, and was complaining of neck and shoulder pain. hatley notified dispatch to get dallas fire rescue in route to the location at 1141. dallas fire rescue arrived on scene at 1144. hatley spoke with witnesses while on scene. prior to ems arrival and while they attended to graham, i took photo evidence of the scene and notified dispatch that i needed a contact number for language line for translation because the driver of the vehicle was spanish speaking only. dispatch was not able to find a phone number for language line but did communicate with the house supervisor patricia hunter. hunter located registered nurse osbaldo castro who is assigned to the emergency department, spanish speaking, english speaking, and employed by methodist. osbaldo was advised by echols to translate the conversation between echols and vega ramos. during questioning echols asked vega ramos what direction was she traveling when she hit graham. vega ramos stated that she was going the [roadway] (which is eastbound). echols asked vega ramos how fast she was going. vega ramos stated that she was driving slowly (did not provide an approximate speed). echols asked vega ramos if she was injured from the impact. vega ramos stated that she was not injured but she did feel bad because she has high blood pressure and tachycardia. echols asked vega ramos if she wanted to be checked out in the emergency department. vega ramos stated no. vega ramos stated she believed graham was not walking in the crosswalk but was walked through the grassed area away from the crosswalk because she did not see graham, she only saw something bounce off of the vehicle. echols asked vega ramos was she using her cell phone, vega ramos replied no. echols asked vega ramos if she was wearing her seat belt, vega ramos replied yes. vega ramos stated she is at methodist charlton about once a week to drop off medication so she knows that people cross at the crosswalk, so she always slow down for people to cross. echols asked vega ramos if she was on any type of medication that may affect her vision, vega ramos stated she is only on blood pressure medication. echols asked vega ramos if she wore glasses, vega ramos stated she does not. after questioning vega ramos echols released her passport, insurance card back to her. the vehicle was released to a licensed driver a family member of vega ramos. after releasing vega ramos and the vehicle from the scene hatley remained on scene for traffic control, sgt. simmons requested engineering to the scene for biohazard removal, obtained photo evidence, and measurements of the scene. the measurements that sgt. simmons obtained are as follows: the point of impact (which was the crosswalk)to where the victim landed was 30 feet, the distance of the vehicle impact point to the vehicle stopping point is 26 feet, the distance between where the victim landed and the left curb is approximately 7 feet 2 inches, and [roadway] in which the driver was driving at the point of impact is 24 feet. based upon the information provided by vega-ramos (the driver), eyewitness statements about what happened, and security video footage i believe vega-ramos being in control of the silver toyota camry failed to yield to graham (a pedestrian in a crosswalk) which caused her to hit graham causing serious bodily injury. officers' body worn cameras were activated during the incident and there were not any other reports of injuries. no further information is available.
